decided: 2026-10-25, WO-02 Track C (ADR-015: tolerances per output and per basis, never one blanket percentage)

basis_classes.floating_point: Same equations and coefficients as the oracle; differences come only from evaluation order, iteration convergence (duct delivery effectiveness, wet bulb) and the oracle rounding its reported loads to 1 Btu/h.
basis_classes.interpolation: Differences from interpolating tabulated data at different points. Not used: the engine interpolates the same tables at the same points as the oracle.
basis_classes.method_difference: Differences from a different method or table source, for example ACCA's own worked examples. Not used yet: no second reference exists until the Manual J 8th edition is on hand.

comparisons.applies_to: every component kind against the oracle's same-named HVAC Design Load line (walls, windows, doors, ceilings, slabs, infiltration, internal gains, AED excursion, ducts)

observed: measured 2026-10-25 on both reference fixtures; the component maximum is the two-story ceiling heating line, where the oracle reports a rounded integer
